title: Mario Felipe, Mano V/S Regla
lede: A 36-page riso-printed artist’s book in an edition of 50, printed in one blue ink on cream and turquoise paper.
summary: Riso artist’s book in blue ink on colored paper stocks, edition of 50.

source.label: Flickr: Mario Felipe, “Mano Vs Regla | Book”

creator.name: Mario Felipe; published by Gran Negro Ediciones

evidence.note: Viewed the 1024 × 728 px Flickr “large” file of an open spread. A second photo shows the cover ([Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/cuandoelsolexplote/23060245766/)).

styles.note: Partial fit: one spot ink on colored stocks, with grainy screened photography. There is no overprint.

context: The Flickr description says: “Editado por Gran Negro Ediciones … Impreso en Risografía. Edición de 50. 20,5 x 13,5 cm. 36 páginas. Primavera 2015.” It links to the author’s own online store.
observed: A single bright blue ink prints on two paper colors: cream on the left page and turquoise on the right.
The left page has a hand-drawn line figure with dots at the corners.
The right page has a photograph of a hand, screened into fine grain, in the same blue.
The paper color changes the apparent color of the ink.
interpretation: The book uses colored stock as a second “color” at no extra drum, a common riso economy.
borrow: Change the page ground between sections and keep one ink, so the palette shifts without new colors.

images.alt: Two hands hold an open booklet. The left page is cream with a blue line drawing; the right page is turquoise with a grainy blue photograph of a hand.
